title: Evaluate the election to distribute AEP first — Sycamore Holdings
instructions: Sycamore Holdings, Inc. converted from a C corporation to an S corporation several years ago. Its sole shareholder, Priya Shah, will receive a $60,000 cash distribution in 2025. The controller prepared a comparison with and without the election to distribute accumulated earnings and profits (AEP) before AAA. Review the comparison and complete the recommendation. Tick every amount that is wrong and enter the correct amount.

exhibits.title: Data before the distribution
exhibits.content:
- Accumulated adjustments account (AAA): **$40,000** (after the year's income).
- Accumulated E&P from C corporation years: **$25,000**.
- Priya's stock basis: **$100,000**.
- Passive investment income (rents and interest) exceeded **25%** of gross receipts in 2023 and 2024 and is projected to do so in 2025.
- Priya's dividend rate: **15%**.

rows.label: Without election — dividend income
rows.explanation: AAA first (40,000 tax-free), then 20,000 from AEP = **20,000** dividend (§1368(c)). **No error.**

rows.label: Without election — stock basis after the distribution
rows.explanation: Only the AAA portion reduces stock basis: 100,000 − 40,000 = **60,000**. Distributions out of AEP are dividends and do not reduce basis.

rows.label: With the election — tax-free distribution from AAA
With the election — stock basis after the distribution
Recommendation
options: Make the election — it eliminates AEP, removing the passive-investment-income tax and the risk of termination
Do not elect — it only increases current tax
The election is unavailable while AAA is positive
rows.answer: Make the election — it eliminates AEP, removing the passive-investment-income tax and the risk of termination
rows.explanation: The extra 5,000 of dividend income costs 750 at 15%. Without AEP, neither §1375 nor §1362(d)(3) can apply, and Sycamore has had passive investment income above 25% for two years running.

rows.label: Consent required for the election
options: All shareholders who receive a distribution during the year
rows.answer: All shareholders who receive a distribution during the year
